basic_details.job_title: SAA Utkal Balashram Bhadrak Recruitment 2026 - Apply Offline for 11 Nurse, Doctor and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: SAA Utkal Balashram Bhadrak has released the official Recruitment 2026 notification for 11 contractual posts including Manager/Coordinator, Social Worker, Nurse, Doctor, Ayahs, and Cook/Chowkidar. Eligible candidates can apply offline on or before 06 August 2026. Check vacancy details, eligibility criteria, age limit, salary, selection process, application procedure, and important dates for SAA Utkal Balashram Bhadrak Recruitment 2026.

age_limit.details: Minimum Age: 21 years Maximum Age: 45 years No relaxation in the upper age limit shall be admissible under any circumstances.

how_to_apply: Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: www.bhadrak.odisha.gov.in.
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
Check all details carefully before submission.
Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.
Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 06-08-2026.
Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.bhadrak.odisha.gov.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 06-08-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the SAA Utkal Balashram Bhadrak recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the SAA Utkal Balashram Bhadrak recruitment is 06 August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the SAA Utkal Balashram Bhadrak posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 11 vacancies announced for various posts in SAA Utkal Balashram Bhadrak.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to send their application form to the official address.

faq.question: Q4. What is the minimum and maximum age limit for the SAA Utkal Balashram Bhadrak posts?
faq.answer: The minimum age limit is 21 years and the maximum age limit is 45 years for all the posts.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for the SAA Utkal Balashram Bhadrak recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category of candidates in the official notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary structure for the SAA Utkal Balashram Bhadrak posts?
faq.answer: The salary ranges from Rs. 7944 to Rs. 23170 per month, depending on the post.

faq.question: Q7. What are the educational qualifications required for the Ayahs post?
faq.answer: Candidates who have completed Under Matric (8th – 10th) are eligible to apply for the Ayahs post.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for these positions?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a Merit List based on the weightage of marks, followed by an interview (if required) and document verification.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website www.bhadrak.odisha.gov.in, and the links are provided in the Important Links section.

faq.question: Q10. What is the address to send the application form?
faq.answer: The specific address to send the application form is mentioned in the official notification. Candidates are advised to refer to the notification for the exact address.
